summary: Tested onboarding feature: 6/6 backend tests passed and 6/6 frontend UI tests passed. Backend covers PATCH /api/auth/me/profile happy path + all 4 validation branches (age<13->422, invalid category->400, invalid region->400, missing token->401) plus GET /me returning onboarding_completed=false for fresh anonymous user. Frontend Playwright verified: fresh anonymous signup routes to /onboarding (testID='onboarding-screen'), all 7 category chips present, 'SELEZIONA TUTTE' toggle selects and unselects (label flips between SELEZIONA TUTTE / TOGLI TUTTE), full onboarding submission (age=27, sex-M, region Lombardia, cat politica) PATCHes profile and routes to home-screen, and page reload after completion goes straight to (tabs) skipping onboarding. Minor: one deprecated React Native web warning about props.pointerEvents from a library (not from feature code).

react_native_issues.issue: Warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' surfaces during onboarding submit and after reload. Likely coming from a library (not from onboarding.tsx or auth.tsx which do not set pointerEvents). Non-blocking, informational only.

critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx correctly guards submission (age range, sex, region, >=1 category) and calls refreshMe() before router.replace('/(tabs)').
index.tsx auth gate correctly branches on user.onboarding_completed; auth.tsx pushes '/' to let gate decide (good pattern).
Backend ProfileBody uses Pydantic Field(ge=13, le=120) which yields 422 automatically; category and region validated with clear Italian error strings.
_public_user returns onboarding_completed as bool with default False — safe for legacy users pre-migration.
seed_data_creation: Fresh anonymous users created per test (nickname prefixed TEST_ / TESTui) — no cleanup performed as data is disposable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_onboarding_profile.py covers full PATCH /api/auth/me/profile contract. Frontend testIDs verified: onboarding-screen, select-all-toggle, cat-{politica|tv|musica|sport|cinema|social|gossip}, age-input, sex-{F|M|other|na}, region-open, region-{Region-Name} (non-alphanumerics replaced with '-'), region-close, onboarding-submit, onboarding-error, home-screen. Anonymous auth is stable and fast for creating test users.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature works end-to-end; no bug found.
